trustBoundaries: Markdown and embed markers are untrusted author content.
Vault paths, document bytes, attachment bytes, and revisions are Host-owned.
External URLs are inert until handed to the isolated Web Viewer.
Rendered HTML is generated only by the bounded renderer before it reaches dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
abuseCasesChecked: Traversal, encoded traversal, unsafe aliases, symlink escapes, and vault-root escapes.
Script, iframe, object, form, SVG, active URL, malformed HTML, and protocol-relative injection.
Malformed MIME and base64 payloads, oversized media/documents, and excessive recursive embeds.
Late Host results, vault replacement, route changes, disposal, and cancelled recovery reads.
Keyboard access to resolved widgets and accessible names for media, PDFs, panels, and controls.

checks.evidence: Host gateway validates canonical vault-relative paths and generation-bound vault references; route embed reads re-check path, generation, source identity, cancellation, and disposal.
Markdown output escapes text and attributes, strips active HTML outside code, allowlists safe raw tags and URLs, and bounds Mermaid, blocks, footnotes, and content.
Embed graph bounds nodes, depth, document bytes, media bytes, warnings, and total content; validates returned paths, MIME types, and strict base64 before rendering.
External HTTP(S) content renders inert by default; viewer actions carry normalized public URLs to the isolated Web Viewer, which validates again before navigation.

Reading, Live Preview, utility panels, media, PDF frames, external actions, and embed widgets expose accessible names; widget keyboard behavior preserves media controls; reduced-motion styles disable transitions and scrolling motion.
Recovery reads guard state-file discovery, open/stat/read phases; snapshot capture guards cancellation and current-vault identity before writes; cancellation regression passes repeatedly.

limitations: Two narrow builtin reviewer attempts timed out after 240 seconds without findings or file changes; the final verdict is a documented manual read-only review, not a completed subagent review.
React Doctor --scope changed exits successfully but reports the pre-existing marketplace component score of 58/100; no embed/recovery files are implicated.
